title: Modern and Charming Cottage
description:
This contemporary and spacious cottage just north of downtown Nashville is a perfect place to rest if you are in town for work or pleasure. It’s beautiful, clean, stylishly decorated, and ready for you. The home is divided into two sections, and you will have exclusive use of the private and separate apartment during your stay: a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, dining and living areas.

The space
This is a beautiful, bright, and clean space.

Guest access
The home is separated into two apartments divided by a locked door and alarm.  The owner may or may not be in the back apartment of the house during your stay. 

The backyard and laundry room are not for guest use at this time.

Guests will have exclusive use of the front porch and seating to enjoy the front yard space.

Other things to note
Guests are welcome to use our driveway for parking.
